name: Spherical Rotation Reparameterization
definition: Reparameterizes spherical integral using spherical rotations to avoid explicit sampling of discontinuities by making the discontinuity point parameter-independent.
summary: Spherical Rotation Reparameterization eliminates gradient discontinuities in volume rendering by applying a spherical rotation to make discontinuity points parameter-independent, avoiding the explicit boundary sampling required by Warped-Area Sampling.
